title: Going-to-the-Sun Road, Rim to Lake
summary: Sunrise at Logan Pass, then the full Going-to-the-Sun Road east to west, ending with dinner in Kalispell.
drive: West Glacier to Kalispell via Going-to-the-Sun Road · 5h · 180 km

segments.name: Segment 1 — Logan Pass at Sunrise and the East Side
segments.blurb: Sunrise from the road's high point; it can close for snow after mid-September.

stops.name: Logan Pass
stops.note: Highest point on Going-to-the-Sun Road, 6,646 ft.

stops.name: Hidden Lake Overlook
stops.q: Hidden Lake Overlook Glacier National Park

stops.name: Saint Mary Falls
stops.q: Saint Mary Falls Glacier National Park

stops.name: Sunrift Gorge

stops.name: Explore Saint Mary

segments.name: Segment 2 — West Side to Kalispell
segments.blurb: Cedar boardwalk and the park's largest lake, then dinner off the mountain.
